parent_structural_notes: In row-0 standard form, five pairwise-disjoint supports avoid the column coordinate inside 7 coordinates, so every weight is <= 3, and a weight-3 entry forces singletons in the other four squares; two weight-2 entries can share a cell [INFERENCE: re-derive].

The n=7 Fact C (alternating a/b walk is one cycle) used odd characteristic. Over GF(8) every single step has order 2, so the connectivity argument must be redone. Parent sketch: in AG(2,8) the a-cells of one square join b-cells at x-offsets (a+b)*c for six distinct c in GF(8) (rows, columns, four other parallel classes); their differences span the additive group, so the graph is connected [INFERENCE: prove in the lane].
The n=7 Fact L (free triples leave two linear classes) needs a GF(8) analogue or a finite replacement for the one-quantum-square class.
